briefing: Markets were flat today: the NASDAQ was unchanged and the S&P 500 rose 0.2%, so there was no clear direction. Cash is $445.88, which is below the $500 minimum for a new buy, so I am holding all 7 positions. I am keeping the cash ready for a stronger up day, when the best-scoring candidates (DPC, HUBS, IRTC, IBP, LMND) can be bought with more confidence.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Dry powder is cash an investor keeps on hand so they can act quickly when a good opportunity comes up. On a flat, directionless day, holding a small cash reserve instead of forcing a trade lets you deploy it later, when market conditions clearly favor buying.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）是指投資者預留的現金，以便在出現良好機會時能迅速出手。在市場橫行、方向不明的日子，與其勉強入市，不如保留少量現金，待市況明確轉強時再部署，往往更有效率。

market_education.summary_en: Major indexes ended the day roughly flat, with the NASDAQ unchanged and the S&P 500 up a modest 0.2%. No news headlines were provided today, so no single event can be named as the cause of the quiet trading. Underneath the flat indexes, some mid-cap names such as HUBS, IRTC and IBP showed bullish momentum signals, while large semiconductor stocks like NVDA and SMCI stayed weak below their 20-day averages.
market_education.summary_zh: 主要指數今日大致持平，納斯達克指數收平，標普500指數僅微升0.2%。由於今日未有相關新聞資料，難以將市場的平靜走勢歸因於單一事件。指數表面平穩，但板塊之間走勢分化：HUBS、IRTC、IBP等中型股呈現偏強的動能訊號，而NVDA、SMCI等大型半導體股則持續疲弱，股價仍低於20日均線。
